items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: He brought him to the Institute just recently. Yeah cool Bix.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. He brought him to the Institute just recently. Yeah cool Bix. Yeah He’s wild. And there is a case of a guy who, and this is where I think a lot of musicians should sort of follow his lead. I mean he can play the old stuff. But have you heard some of his more out stuff?
Yeah. His writing. Yeah. He did the thing for old time string instruments.
